title: Philosophy
blurb: The love of wisdom — how to think, and how to live.

planned.title: The Tao Te Ching
planned.author: Laozi
planned.note: Eighty-one chapters on the way that cannot be named and the power that works by yielding.

planned.title: On the Nature of Things
planned.author: Lucretius
planned.note: Lucretius sets the whole universe in verse — atoms, mortality, and freedom from the fear of death.

planned.title: The Enneads
planned.author: Plotinus
planned.note: Plotinus and the last great vision of pagan philosophy — the soul's ascent toward the One.

planned.title: The New Organon
planned.author: Francis Bacon
planned.note: Bacon's manifesto for a new science built on experiment and evidence rather than authority.

planned.title: Discourse on Method
planned.author: René Descartes
planned.note: Descartes founds modern philosophy on doubt — 'I think, therefore I am.'

planned.title: Pensées
planned.author: Blaise Pascal
planned.note: Pascal's fragments on faith and doubt — the wager, the abyss, and the thinking reed.

planned.title: Ethics
planned.author: Baruch Spinoza
planned.note: Spinoza proves a philosophy like geometry — God, nature, and freedom as one necessary order.

planned.title: The Critique of Pure Reason
planned.author: Immanuel Kant
planned.note: Kant remakes philosophy — what the mind can know, and the limits it cannot cross.

planned.title: The Philosophy of History
planned.author: G. W. F. Hegel
planned.note: Hegel reads all of history as the unfolding of freedom — the idea that shaped the modern age.

planned.title: Fear and Trembling
planned.author: Søren Kierkegaard
planned.note: Kierkegaard on Abraham and the leap of faith — the birth of existential thought.

planned.title: Beyond Good and Evil
planned.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
planned.note: Nietzsche's assault on inherited morality — and his demand that we create our own values.

planned.title: The Yoga Sutras
planned.author: Patanjali
planned.note: Patanjali's terse map of the mind and the eightfold path to stilling it.

planned.title: The Kama Sutra
planned.author: Vatsyayana
planned.note: Far more than its reputation — Vatsyayana's classical treatise on desire, love, and the art of living well.

planned.title: The Tirukkural
planned.author: Tiruvalluvar
planned.note: Tamil couplets on virtue, wealth, and love — South India's most beloved book of wisdom.

planned.title: The I Ching
planned.author: Anonymous
planned.note: The Book of Changes — the oracle and cosmology at the root of Chinese thought.

planned.title: The Mozi
planned.author: Mozi
planned.note: Mozi's case against Confucius — impartial love, plain living, and the first logic in China.

planned.title: The Doctrine of the Mean
planned.author: Attributed to Zisi
planned.note: One of the Confucian Four Books — the path of balance and sincerity at the still center of all things.

planned.title: The Mencius
planned.author: Mencius
planned.note: The 'second sage' of Confucianism — human nature is good, and a ruler governs by virtue or not at all.

planned.title: The Zhuangzi
planned.author: Zhuangzi
planned.note: Philosophy by parable and joke — the man who dreams he is a butterfly; the freest book in the tradition.

planned.title: The Virtuous City
planned.author: Al-Farabi
planned.note: Al-Farabi imagines the ideal state — Plato's Republic remade for the Islamic world.

planned.title: The Decisive Treatise
planned.author: Averroes
planned.note: Averroes argues that philosophy and revelation, rightly read, cannot conflict — the book that taught Europe Aristotle.

planned.title: The Book of Five Rings & Hagakure
planned.author: Musashi & Tsunetomo
planned.note: The way of the warrior from two sides — a duelist's strategy and a samurai's meditations on death.

planned.title: The Consolation of Philosophy
planned.author: Boethius
planned.note: Awaiting execution, Boethius is visited by Philosophy herself — the most read book of the Middle Ages after the Bible.

planned.title: Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus
planned.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein
planned.note: Seven austere propositions on the limits of language — 'whereof one cannot speak, thereof one must be silent.'

planned.title: The Second Sex
planned.author: Simone de Beauvoir
planned.note: 'One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman' — the foundation of modern feminist thought.

planned.title: Apology, Crito & Phaedo
planned.author: Plato
planned.note: The trial, imprisonment, and death of Socrates — the founding drama of the examined life.

planned.title: The Golden Sayings
planned.author: Epictetus
planned.note: The Stoic handbook of the slave-philosopher: master what is yours, accept what is not.

planned.title: On Friendship & On Old Age
planned.author: Cicero
planned.note: Cicero's wise essays on the goods that ripen with age.

planned.title: An Essay Concerning Human Understanding
planned.author: John Locke
planned.note: Locke on the mind as a blank slate — the foundation of empiricism.

planned.title: Principles of Human Knowledge
planned.author: George Berkeley
planned.note: Berkeley's startling case that to be is to be perceived.

planned.title: An Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding
planned.author: David Hume
planned.note: Hume's elegant skepticism — cause, habit, and the limits of reason.
